title: micromenu
summary: MSUI's micro menu (Program.ActionBars.cs DrawMicroMenu) matches the reference row: eight 29x58 buttons at the bar's x=552 recess with real UI-MicroButton-* Up/Down art, the character button's live portrait overlay, the 18px top hit-rect inset, shared additive highlight, pushed-state tracking against each panel's open flag, and all eight clicks wired (Character, Spellbook, Talents, Quest Log, Social, World Map, Game Menu incl. the modal click-through law, Help). Benilla still has Help as a no-op, so MSUI is ahead there.

openItems.text: Tooltip is a single line - no NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_* second paragraph (1.12 ships detailed tips ON by default)
Binding-key suffix is hardcoded in the labels ('(C)', '(P)', '(Esc)') instead of resolved live from the binding table, so rebinding does not update the tooltips and most buttons show no key at all
No talent-button level gating (reference disables/re-labels below level 10)
